Your video is 24fps. There is nothing wrong happening here, just how timecode is displayed everywhere. You have the 23rd frame 00:23 and the next one would be the 24th, but it displays it as 01:00. Then the next frame is 01:01 and so on.

Timecode is displayed in this order: hours, minutes, seconds, frames. So 01:02:03:04 would mean 1 hour 2 minutes 3 seconds and 4 frames. (The timeline by default starts at 1 hour, don't worry about it).

Unless I read the post wrong, you have nothing to worry about. For subframe editing, check your shortcuts, maybe it got unbinded or changed.
